dragon_intro: ^The cavern shakes. An ancient dragon uncoils from a lake of fire, eyes like furnace doors.
^"Another band of champions? You will make fine ash."
^Taunt it — "Your fire is nothing to us."
^Study it — read its stance before you strike.

c-0: ^Its nostrils flare. It rears back, already gathering flame in its throat.
c-1: ^You watch how the flames coil around it: fire FEEDS this beast — but ice will bite deep.
c-2: ^The dragon's roar shakes dust from the ceiling. Battle is joined.
